verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly show running multiple agent tasks in parallel via asyncio.gather(), plus API support for automation/scripting and cloud/enterprise backends that could host many concurrent agent sessions, and webhook-driven automations (Slack/GitHub/Linear) that can trigger many agent runs. However this is dev-level/API-level parallelism rather than a dedicated fleet-management or throughput-scaling dashboard for engineering leads. Missing for 10: evidence of built-in orchestration/monitoring UI for managing many concurrent agents, documented concurrency limits/scaling guarantees, and case studies showing throughput at scale.
